items.title: Transfer must check identityRegistry.isVerified
items.desc: In `transfer` or `transferFrom`, the token must call `identityRegistry.isVerified` to ensure the recipient is eligible.

items.title: Token must call compliance.canTransfer hook
items.desc: Before executing transfers, token should invoke `compliance.canTransfer(from, to, amount)` to enforce additional compliance rules.

items.title: ClaimTopicsRegistry must support add/remove and event emission
items.desc: Claim Topics Registry must expose `addClaimTopic`, `removeClaimTopic`, `getClaimTopics`, and emit `ClaimTopicAdded`/`ClaimTopicRemoved` events.

items.title: IdentityRegistry must support setter for ClaimTopicsRegistry
items.desc: Identity Registry should allow updating the associated ClaimTopicsRegistry via `setClaimTopicsRegistry(address)`.

items.title: IdentityRegistry must support setter for TrustedIssuersRegistry
items.desc: Identity Registry must allow updating the Trusted Issuers Registry via `setTrustedIssuersRegistry(address)`.

items.title: Identity Registry must expose isVerified view function
items.desc: Identity Registry should have `isVerified(address)` to allow checking eligibility off-chain or from token.

items.title: Token must emit IdentityRegistryAdded and ComplianceAdded
items.desc: Token should emit `IdentityRegistryAdded(address)` and `ComplianceAdded(address)` events when wiring these contracts.

items.title: Token must support freezing / unfreezing of address
items.desc: Token should implement `setAddressFrozen(address, bool)` or similar to control freezing of accounts.

items.title: Token must be compatible with ERC-20 interface
items.desc: ERC-3643 tokens must implement standard ERC-20 functions: `transfer`, `approve`, `allowance`, etc.

items.title: Token must support recovery functionality
items.desc: Token should implement recovery mechanism in case an investor loses keys, e.g., `recover(address lost, address new)`.

items.title: Customer Due Diligence (CDD) before first transaction
items.desc: The system should enforce identity verification (KYC) before any token transfer is executed.

items.title: Record keeping retention ≥ 5 years
items.desc: Audit or transaction logs must be kept for at least 5 years, retrievable on demand.

items.title: Beneficial ownership identification
items.desc: For entity accounts, beneficial owners must be identified and verified as part of KYC flow.

items.title: Ongoing transaction monitoring / suspicious flags
items.desc: Transfers exceeding thresholds or patterns should trigger flags / review logic.

items.title: Freezing high-risk accounts or sanctions screening
items.desc: System supports freezing or blocking accounts identified as high risk or sanctioned.

items.title: Client identity rule: identity on file prior to transaction
items.desc: Before executing token-related operations, verify that client identity info is on file compliant with SFC §5.4.

items.title: Timely disclosure of client identity to regulators
items.desc: Client identity records must be retrievable and deliverable to regulators within required timeframe.

items.title: Record changes in identity / KYC data
items.desc: When identity or KYC status changes, the system must emit an event for auditability.

items.title: Internal control & compliance function oversight
items.desc: The token-related operations must respect separation of roles, oversight, and error control.

items.title: Conflicts of interest disclosure & fairness
items.desc: If token logic includes privileged roles, their actions should be transparent via events or logs.
